newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures finish lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures finish lower.

text.p: Oct 21 - U.S. stock index futures ended down amid afternoon Nasdaq and bond weakness. Dec S&P 500 hit an all-time high at 718.70 early in the session then the contract drifted lower, attracting profit-taking below a 15-minute trendline at 715.80, a trader said. Traders said jitters in tech stocks undermined early followthrough rallies from Friday.
